text: Every update app doesn't bring anything else than new bugs. One of worse app i have ever tried. Very limited functionality. Developer doesn't respond to any questions. I have similar app Routinery, which is free with up to 2 routines too, which is next level. There is no option to choose alarm, no repeated alarm after time passed or was paused, no option to show remaining time, max. task time only 45 min with free ver., no adjust time, no routine preview...
author: Danny D.
developer_reply: There is a widget now, it's possible to select alarms as an option and the remaining time is shown. You get notifications after time in your routine has passed. I'm definitely trying to add updates fairly quickly which you should be able to see.

text: Missing: - the ability to add or take away time from a task - automatic moving on to next task - switching timer to countdown Otherwise amazing. I've already basically moved from Routinery to RoutineFlow as the paid version is way more financially ethical towards users (never paid for Routinety) and you don't have to deal with bugs every 15 minutes. A few more features and it's perfect for me. 😊
author: Daniel Benda
